description:
Inspect a SQLite or D1 database for operational faults: corruption (PRAGMA integrity check), WAL bloat from a starved checkpoint, freelist fragmentation, and reachability. Returns a JSON report with a severity (ok / warning / critical) and a list of issues. Read-only.

For D1: set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and use source=d1://DB_ID.

deep.description: Use the exhaustive integrity_check instead of the faster quick_check

source.description: Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

name: litescope_health
title: Inspect database health
